title: Leaf rectangle count is at most two to the complexity
statement: Let $p$ be a deterministic two-party communication protocol over input types $X$ and $Y$ producing values in $\alpha$, and let $c$ be its communication complexity. Then the number of leaf rectangles of $p$ is at most $2^{c}$.
hypotheses_covered: p is a deterministic communication protocol over X, Y with values in α
c is the communication complexity of p
replaced:
For any protocol $p$ with communication complexity $c = p.\texttt{complexity}$, the number of
leaf rectangles satisfies $|\texttt{leafRectangles}(p)| \leq 2^c$.
